mexico-reef-2026-unnamed.text: Reported completed in 2026 (Raised Water Research, 31 Mar 2026); location, design and performance not yet published.
mexico-reef-2026-unnamed.quote: On April 16 at 6:30 PM, the California Surf Club will host the unveiling of a newly completed artificial surf reef off the coast of Mexico ... reef designer Simon Brandi Mortensen and Raised Water Research founder Peter Indelicato will reveal the reef's location and debut never-before-seen footage of the reef in action.
mexico-reef-2026-unnamed.ref: Indelicato, P. (2026-03-31). Unveiling the new reef in Mexico. Raised Water Research, Surf Reef News.
mexico-reef-2026-unnamed.why: Lior 2026-10-24 (D11, correction): we know almost nothing about it; only in a collapsible part at the bottom of the Gallery; excluded from the Table, the 3D reef list, counts, averages and sorts. Status check: 08_paper/notes/xala_status_check.md.

avg_cost.rule: Reefs that did not break: B (safety and longevity) score 3 or more. Excluded: B = 1 failed (Boscombe, Kovalam, Mount Maunganui, Pratte's, Opunake, Bunbury Airwave), B = 2 hazard (Albany), Borth (coastal defence; its cost is the whole scheme) and Xala (no cost).
avg_cost.basis: US$ million at 2024 prices: each whole-project cost as reported, converted to US dollars at the World Bank annual-average exchange rate of its price year and raised to 2024 with the US consumer price index (paper, Section 2 and Table 1 notes)

volume_reported._source: 08_paper/sections/03_survey.md, Table 1, column 'Volume, reported (m^3)' (as stated by the sources; not one common quantity, see the paper's notes); read 2026-10-24
